quests.name: The Wolfrun Cart
quests.text: Hilda's supply cart never came down the Wolfrun Trail, and wolves prowl the road. Find the cart above the Wolfrun Climb, see what drew the pack, and bring Hilda the three sacks they dragged off.

quests.name: Pelts for the Tanner
quests.text: The Marshal's wolves left good fur behind. Bring me five wolf pelts from the Wolfrun Woods.

quests.name: The Missing Farmhand
quests.text: Those sacks were cut, and that bait was laid on purpose: Redbrand work, I wager. And my farmhand never came back from Millbrook. Follow the Millbrook Road east and ask Farmer Osric Mill.

quests.name: Marauders in the Fields
quests.text: Marauders took my fields, and my farmhand ran from them. Drive them off: defeat eight Field Marauders.

quests.name: Scout the Lake
quests.text: Something stirs at Stillwater Lake, south-east of the outpost. Scout it, then report to the Marshal.

quests.name: Mirefin Menace
quests.text: Mirefin lurkers foul the lake's shallows. Slay six of them.

quests.name: Into Redbrand Hollow
quests.text: The Redbrand bandits camp in the hollow under the northern cliffs. Break their camp: defeat ten of them.

quests.name: Garrick Redbrand
quests.text: Garrick Redbrand holds the mine entrance at the back of the hollow. End his raids.

quests.name: Return to Greyhaven
quests.text: The vale is safe again. Tell Tanner Hilda Brook that Greyhaven stands, and take her thanks.

quests.name: The Sunken Shrine
quests.text: Old stones lie at the bottom of Stillwater Lake, and a flooded cave runs east from them. Dive down, bring back the relic from its altar, and mind your breath.

quests.name: Deeper into the Hollow
quests.text: Garrick is gone, but his men still hold the Greyfang cave east of the hollow, and shield-bearing brutes guard a sealed way deeper. Break two Redbrand Brutes and see what they guard.

quests.name: The Captain Below
quests.text: Garrick's ledger names the man he answered to: Captain Ulric Thorn, who rules the Redbrands from the depths under the Greyfang cave. Take friends you trust and end him, or tell me it is already done.

quests.name: Word from the Downs
quests.text: Barrowdown on the King's Road Downs has sent no grain this season. Take the Fen Road and the Fenwater Link south and ask Gwen Barrow at the Barrow Rest what is wrong.

quests.name: Raiders on the Downs
quests.text: Marauders camp in the hollow south of the knoll and raid our carts on the King's Road. Drive them off: defeat six Field Marauders.

quests.name: Grain for the Barrow Rest
quests.text: They carried off our grain in sacks. Bring four of them back from the marauders, and the Barrow Rest will brew again.

quests.name: The Barrow Ring
quests.text: Old Maud keeps the barrow ring west of the hamlet and swears the stones are restless. Humour an old woman: go and hear her out.

quests.name: Down to the Ford
quests.text: Hob Ferris at the Ford Inn buys our ale and sells us news. Follow the Fen Road east to Fenford and tell him the Barrow Rest is brewing again.

quests.name: Tusks and Tallow
quests.text: The boars by the Fenwater grow fat and bold. Bring me five tusks for the carver, and the tallow pays your supper.

quests.name: The Fenwater Raiders
quests.text: Marauders watch the ford from the meadows across the Fenwater. Walk the crossing and break them: defeat four.

quests.name: The Lodge on the Tarn
quests.text: The fisher at Westmere Lodge sends word of trouble on the tarn. Follow the Westmere Road west from the Wolfrun Climb and find Brann.

quests.name: Scales of Westmere
quests.text: Lurkers crept up the beck into the tarn and foul my nets. Bring me four of their scales so the lodge believes it.

quests.name: Wolves at the Water
quests.text: Wolf packs come down through Westmere Woods to drink at dusk. Thin them: slay eight timber wolves.

quests.name: The Hunters' Camp
quests.text: Edric Vale's hunters camp on the Southwood Trail. He pays for good hands. Take the Westwood Track south through the woods and find him.

quests.name: Southwood Hunt
quests.text: The camp needs meat and the trails need clearing. Bring down six boars and four wolves in Southwood.

quests.name: The Greyfang Watch
quests.text: With Garrick gone the Redbrands still ride the Greyfang Road. Watchman Garth holds the tower below the mountains; go up through the Highland Pass and report to him.

quests.name: Orders on the Road
quests.text: Their crossbowmen carry written orders. Take three from them on the Greyfang Road, and we will know where they are bound.

quests.name: The Delving Workings
quests.text: The orders name the Delving Workings east of the lookout: the Redbrands have taken the miners' camp. Go there by the Delving Track and break them: defeat six bandits.

quests.name: Ogres of the Heights
quests.text: Hill ogres roam the Delving Heights and the miners will not go back while they do. Fell two of them.

quests.name: The Hamlets
quests.text: With the marauders gone the hamlets up the farm road can sow again, but they are short of hands. Take the road north past the fields and find Goodwife Ena in the western hamlet.

quests.name: Rats in the Granary
quests.text: Rats have got into the barn and the haystack, and what they leave the damp takes. Kill eight of them before they eat the seed corn.

quests.name: Boars in the Barley
quests.text: Miller Hanne down at the southern hamlet says boars root up the barley west of her mill every night. Bring down five of them, then tell her the fields are safe.

quests.name: The Shepherd's Wolves
quests.text: A wolf pack hunts east of the eastern hamlet's pastures, and Shepherd Lise has lost two ewes. Slay five wolves and let her know her flock can graze again.

quests.name: Cut Sacks, Red Rags
quests.text: The pack never found my cart by chance. Go back up the Wolfrun Climb and look hard at the cut sacks, the meat rack hung by the cart and that red-ragged stake beside the trail. Then tell me what you make of it.

quests.name: The Bait Trail
quests.text: Whoever hung that bait dragged it up from somewhere: scraps lead off the trail, and a second red rag hangs in the trees. Follow them to where the courier hid his goods, then tell the Marshal what you found.

quests.name: A Guard's Last Watch
quests.text: Tam Hollis kept watch on the Wolfrun Climb and never came down. If he lives, bind his wounds with this bandage and bring him back inside the palisade. Stay by him: he cannot walk fast, and he will not walk alone.

quests.name: The Tanner's Ledger
quests.text: My ledger says three loads went to Millbrook this month; Osric swears he got two. Read my ledger on the strongbox here, ask Osric, and check the tally on his delivery crates. Tell me which load went missing.

quests.name: The Smith's Trial
quests.text: Wulfric forged trial arms for the watch and wants them proven on Redbrands, not straw. Take the one that suits your hand, fell two bandits with it, tell him how it held, then bring it back to me. It is a loan.

quests.name: Stone on the Road
quests.text: There is a loose boulder on the slope above the Hollow. Draw Redbrands into its path and send it down on them. I want them broken by the hill, not by your blade: let the stone do the work twice.

quests.name: Breaking the Watch Post
quests.text: The Redbrands' watch post by the Hollow Road sees everything we send. Bring down both walls that hold up its deck, with fire, powder or arrows, and tell me when the deck is in the dirt.

quests.name: A Quiet Introduction
quests.text: Davin Moss saw who met that courier, but he will not speak to anyone who deals in the arcane. If that is you, bring a party mate he trusts, or Hilda's good word. Hear him out, then come back to me.

quests.name: The Man at the Gate
quests.text: Davin's courier waits outside the east gate as if he owns the road. Question him, then show him this toll pass he dropped in the Wolfrun Woods. If he is a Redbrand, he will not come quietly.

quests.name: The Miller's Medicine
quests.text: Miller Hanne's farmhand Jory is down with a wound fever. Carry this draught to her mill, then see that Jory drinks it himself. Not a drop spilled: it is the last I have until the herbs come in.
